specs.title: four useful tabs, first-area BYOK, direct Markdown and corner tools; no automatic external calls

real controls change hover transform, review data and handoff reimport keeps parameters
fixed proposal is explicitly imported, recipe validation blocks success, approved r2 has complete links
simulated BYOK response creates a candidate only; Key absent from storage and exports, cleared after reload

simulated network and invalid proposal never replace manual prose or create false success
editing while a simulated model request is running makes candidate stale
simulated PKCE popup callback exchanges code and verifier without persisting credentials
malicious imports leave original data and do not execute Markdown scripts
two tabs detect CAS conflict and preserve the unsaved page for backup
100 requirements stay directly editable and Markdown import becomes the actual document

candidate can become editable prose before any approval and can still be rejected
